reviews.title: Didn’t honor lifelong purchase
reviews.text:
I purchased this app back in 2023 when they had the model where you could purchase once and have it forever.  I went to use app recently, so I could redo program and it wasn’t working.  I would get to the check list and when I’d go to check an item off, I’d get prompted to purchase again either monthly or annually.  I emailed and they said I should still have access and shouldn’t have to pay again as they confirmed I’m a life long member.  They told me to do a couple steps like delete/readd/logout, etc., I tried and it still didn’t work.  The app still wants to charge a second time for use.  No one has emailed me back since after I told them their instructions didn’t work.  They also could fix on their end but instead tried to make me jump hoops.  I will not be purchasing again and at this point I’m 5 days into the program so if they ever do reach out, by now it’s pointless as I’ve found other ways to accomplish the same thing.  

The actual program is good but the app and customer service has been a let down for me.

reviews.title: Idiots in the reviews
reviews.text:
To all the people coming here to say “ I paid for this app years ago and now they want to charge me a subscription” 

If you purchased the app 
Years ago ( like I did) you’re grandfathered in. You get the app completely free. 
You need to sign into the original email, or Apple ID that you used when you purchased the app.  
It took me all of two minutes to figure this out.

If you’re really taking time out of your day to complain about something, you did no research on. I hate to break it to you, but you’re not going to finish 75Hard with that fragile mindset.

reviews.title: The app was better before…
reviews.text:
When I first attempted 75 Hard, this app was great. It cost $5 and helped keep me on track as it’s just a checklist when it comes down to it. A simple app and a simple price, lessening the bar to entry. 

Now, as I’ve come back to go at it again, I find while I’m trying to take my first progress picture that it’s subscription based. Either monthly (which we all know it’s at least 3 months we will have to pay for) or pay for it for the year at $40. Although maybe this doesn’t sound like much, I had already paid that $5 entry fee back in around 2021 or 2022.

In a world full of subscriptions, and for a simple app, charging this ridiculous fee shows that now it’s just money driven more than progress/life changing driven. The bar to entry was easy and this was a nice little companion app to help keep progress for changing your life a day at a time. 

For the price, I wouldn’t recommend this app at all. There are others out there now that can do the same thing, or you could just create your own daily check off. Shoot, a journal costs less than this. 

If you want or care about a suggestion, bring back the one time $5 price tag for the app and remove the subscription bs. Also, as a bit of a side note, consider including the app or a 75 day subscription  (if you keep that model) when buying Andy’s book on mental toughness. 

I’m not shooting down the program in the least bit. The app is/was great for something super simple, but it’s far from worth the price tag they’ve put on it now. I hate even saying this because the program is amazing and has changed my life and many other friend’s lives that I’ve introduced it to.

K.I.S.S….Keep It Simple Stupid. Sending love along with my frustration.
